src/parametric/Block.cpp.reason: Core parametric block entity model and effective geometry calculation; scheduled for Phase 3.

src/tools/LineFactory.cpp.reason: Line segment creation logic; scheduled for Phase 3.

src/app/ContextStrip.cpp.reason: Context property strip UI layout and field sync; scheduled for Phase 3.

src/parametric/Resolver.cpp.reason: Constraint resolver; resolveAll 553-line function scheduled for pipeline refactor.

src/document/commands/ReverseSegmentComm.reason: Reverse segment command implementation; minor overshoot of 400-line model command target.

tests/test_select_wkey.cpp.reason: Giant select-wkey test suite; scheduled for Phase 3 split.

ParamPoint.reason: Constraint & interpolation flag fields on data entity struct; evaluated as model fields. EVALUATED 2026-09-04: isAuxiliary/visible/selectable/showName/resolved are persistent model fields; tangentLocked/autoTangent/interBidirectional are tangent/interpolation config flags each independently driving render/resolve branches, no composite hidden state machine; retained per Rule 附1 (pure data/config fields exempt).

ContextStrip.reason: Session & pin state flags in strip; EVALUATED 2026-09-04: m_connectSession/m_rotateSession/m_strokePreview/m_creationPinned are INDEPENDENT session markers driving distinct UI conditions (no boolean cross-product hidden states); retained per Rule 附1 (pure config/session fields exempt).

Props.reason: Snapshot property struct fields mirroring Segment visibility toggles.
